results.description:
My father's will is a trap, and my grumpy, flannel-clad neighbor is the key.

As a high-powered Boston lawyer, I see my family's failing Vermont farm as just another asset to liquidate. But an impossible clause in the will forces me to work the land for one last harvest—or lose everything to Dustin Bishop, the man who's been coveting our property for years.

He's my sworn enemy, my reluctant partner, and the last person I should be sharing cozy nights with by a crackling fire. He thinks I'm just a city girl who will cut and run back to her ambition. I think he's a stubborn farmer stuck in the past.

But as the autumn leaves fall, I start to wonder if the life I fought so hard to escape is the only one I want. Can I win this fight for my father's legacy without losing my heart to the one man who stands to gain from my failure?
